H2446.name: Hacaliah
H2446.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2446.brief: Father of Nehemiah, the governor of Judah.
H2446.short: Hacaliah was the father of Nehemiah, who served as the governor of Judah during the Persian period.

H2453H.name: Hachmoni
H2453H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2453H.brief: Father of Jehiel, one of David's family servants.
H2453H.short: Hachmoni was the father of Jehiel who, with Jonathan attended King David's sons.

H2453G.name: Hachmonites
H2453G.brief: A clan or family known for their mighty warriors.
H2453G.short: The Hachmonites, also known as the Tahchemonites, were a clan or family that produced some of David's mighty warriors.

H2412.name: Hatipha
H2412.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2412.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from exile.
H2412.short: Hatipha was an ancestor of temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

H2410.name: Hatita
H2410.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2410.brief: Ancestor of gatekeepers who returned from exile.
H2410.short: Hatita was an ancestor of gatekeepers who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

H2411.name: Hattil
H2411.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2411.brief: Ancestor of Solomon's servants who returned from exile.
H2411.short: Hattil was an ancestor of Solomon's servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

H2407G.name: Hattush
H2407G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2407G.brief: A descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah.
H2407G.short: Hattush was a descendant of King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) of Judah.

H2407H.name: Hattush
H2407H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2407H.brief: A descendant of David, who returned from exile.
H2407H.short: Hattush, a descendant of David, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H2407J.name: Hattush
H2407J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2407J.brief: A priest who sealed the covenant and returned with Zerubbabel.
H2407J.short: Hattush was a priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah and returned with Zerubbabel.

H2407I.name: Hattush
H2407I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2407I.brief: Son of Hashabneiah, a repairer of Jerusalem's wall.
H2407I.short: Hattush, son of Hashabneiah, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

H2458.name: Helah
H2458.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2458.brief: One of the two wives of Ashhur.
H2458.short: Helah was one of the two wives of Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, from the tribe of Judah.

H2469G.name: Heldai
H2469G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2469G.brief: A returned exile who helped crown Joshua.
H2469G.short: Heldai (or Helem), a returned exile, was one of those who provided silver and gold to make a crown for Joshua the high priest.

H2460.name: Heleb
H2460.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H2460.short: Heleb (also known as Heldai or Heled) was one of David's mighty warriors, a Netophathite.

H2497.name: Helon
H2497.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2497.brief: Father of Eliab, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun.
H2497.short: Helon was the father of Eliab, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun during the wilderness wanderings.

H2419.name: Hiel
H2419.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2419.short: Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho during the reign of King Ahab, fulfilling Joshua's curse on the city.

H2437.name: Hirah
H2437.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2437.short: Hirah was an Adullamite who was a close friend of Judah, the son of Jacob.

H2438H.name: Hiram
H2438H.desc: Syrian living at the time of United Monarchy
H2438H.short: Hiram, a skilled craftsman from Tyre, was commissioned by Solomon to create the bronze furnishings for the temple.

H2438G.name: Hiram
H2438G.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H2438G.brief: King of Tyre, ally of David and Solomon.
H2438G.short: Hiram, king of Tyre, provided materials and craftsmen for the construction of David's palace and Solomon's temple and palace.

H2468.name: Huldah
H2468.desc: Prophetess living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2468.brief: A prophetess during the reign of King Josiah.
H2468.short: Huldah was a prophetess who was consulted by King Josiah's officials regarding the authenticity of the Book of the Law discovered during temple repairs.

H2444.name: Hachilah
H2444.brief: A hill in the Wilderness of Ziph, near David's hideout.
H2444.short: Hachilah was a hill in the Wilderness of Ziph, where David hid from Saul and where the Ziphites revealed David's location to Saul (<ref="1Sa.23.19; 26:1">1Sa.23.19; 26:1, 3</ref>).

H2477.name: Halah
H2477.brief: A place where Israelites were exiled by the Assyrians.
H2477.short: Halah was one of the places where the Assyrians settled the exiled Israelites after conquering the Northern Kingdom.

H2478.name: Halhul
H2478.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah.
H2478.short: Halhul was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah, located in the hill country (<ref="Joshua 15:58">Joshua 15:58</ref>).

H2482.name: Hali
H2482.brief: A town allotted to the tribe of Asher.
H2482.short: Hali was a town allotted to the tribe of Asher (<ref="Joshua 19:25">Joshua 19:25</ref>).

H2431.name: Helam
H2431.brief: Place where David defeated the Arameans
H2431.short: Helam was the location of a battle between David's forces and the Arameans, where David defeated Hadadezer, king of Zobah, and his allies (<ref="2Sa.10.16-17">2Sa.10.16-17</ref>).

H2462.name: Helbah
H2462.brief: Canaanite town not conquered by the tribe of Asher
H2462.short: Helbah was a Canaanite town that the tribe of Asher failed to conquer during the period of the judges (<ref="Judg 1:31">Judg 1:31</ref>).

H2463.name: Helbon
H2463.brief: City known for its fine wine
H2463.short: Helbon was a city mentioned in <ref="Ezk.27.18">Ezk.27.18</ref> as a trading partner of Tyre, known for its fine wine.

H2428B.name: Helech
H2428B.brief: A place or people mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy.
H2428B.short: Helech was either a place, possibly in Cilicia, or a term referring to the army of Tyre, mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy against Tyre.

H2473H.name: Holon
H2473H.short: Holon, a city of Moab mentioned in Jeremiah's oracle against Moab.

H2473G.name: Holon
H2473G.brief: Levitical city in the hill country of Judah
H2473G.short: Holon, a Levitical city in Judah's hill country, also called Hilen.
